verdict.rationale: Factory's docs state that droid exec 'uses tiered autonomy to control what operations can run without manual confirmation', which matches the story almost word for word. The interactive CLI is also described as having approvals, and the app shows proposed changes before applying them. missing for 10: documentation of the actual autonomy tiers and what each permits, evidence that tiers apply beyond droid exec (e.g., interactive and app sessions), org- or team-level enforcement that an engineering lead could set for others, independent or hands-on corroboration.
